title: Italian greetings and basics
examples: How do I say hello in Italian?
What is the Italian word for thank you?

explain.say: Today we learn some simple Italian words. We will learn how to say hello.

items: It is very useful to know

explain.say: Another greeting is buongiorno. You can say this in the morning.
Next we learn numbers one to five. One is uno. Two is due.
To ask for something, you say per favore. This means please.

items: It is polite to use it

explain.say: When you receive something, you say grazie. This means thank you.
Imagine you are buying gelato in Italy. You want a scoop of pistachio.

faq.q: What do I say if I meet someone in the afternoon?
faq.a: You can use buongiorno for most of the day. If it gets later, you might use a different greeting.
asks: Is buongiorno only for the morning?
What greeting do I use in the afternoon?

faq.q: Do I need to say 'per favore' every time?
faq.a: It is always good to use per favore. It shows respect to the person you are speaking to.
asks: When is it okay not to say per favore?

faq.q: How do I say 'thank you' if I am talking to many people?
faq.a: You still say grazie. It is the standard way to say thank you to everyone.
asks: What is the plural for thank you?

faq.q: If I want to buy three apples, how do I say that?
faq.a: You would say 'tre mele'. You use the number followed by the item name.
asks: How do I count things in Italian?
Do I change the number for apples?

faq.q: Is 'ciao' okay to use all day long?
faq.a: Ciao is very casual. It is fine with friends, but maybe use buongiorno with strangers.

facts: Ciao can mean both hello and goodbye.
Buongiorno is used as a general greeting during the day.
Uno is the Italian word for the number one.
Grazie means thank you in Italian.

quiz.say: If you meet a shopkeeper in the morning, what should you say?
quiz.why: Buongiorno is the correct greeting to use during the day.

wrong.1: Ciao is more casual and might not be appropriate for a shopkeeper.
wrong.2: Grazie means thank you, not a greeting.
wrong.3: Uno is the word for the number one.

quiz.say: You need to ask for help. Which word means please?
quiz.why: Per favore is the polite way to ask for something.

wrong.0: Due is the Italian word for the number two.
wrong.2: Grazie means thank you, not please.
wrong.3: Ciao is used for greeting people.

quiz.say: If you receive a gift, you should say:
quiz.why: Grazie is the standard way to say thank you.

wrong.0: Per favore is used when you are asking for something.
wrong.1: Buongiorno is a greeting, not a thank you.
wrong.2: Uno is a number, not a thank you word.
